  the trick

The prompt doesn't describe the product. It describes the colors, the print texture and where every line of text goes.

The 8 style
prompts

same headphones, 8 directions

Fill the slots before you send: [SUBJECT] your product with material, colour and angle · [TITLE] the big word · [SUB] the small lines: dates, specs, tagline · [C1] [C2] your colours · [SETTING] a place · [FORMAT] the size, e.g. vertical 3:4.

style 01 / 08[ F7 ]

Gorpcore object branding

Techwear red. The one I picked for the kit.

A [FORMAT] poster on a slightly warm off-white scanned-paper texture with faint fold creases and subtle horizontal scan banding. Centre, a desaturated grayscale photograph of [SUBJECT], cleanly cut out and floating, with high-detail grain and a soft contact shadow, about 60 percent of the frame.

Overlaid across its middle, a tight cluster of flat fluorescent [C1] techwear vector graphics: a chunky rounded sans-serif logotype "[TITLE]" with a small superscript number; under it two lines of narrow condensed caps; a pill-shaped stamp with a short claim; a year inside bracket glyphs; and a scatter of tiny icons (a crosshair star, a half-filled circle, a checkerboard square, a caret). [SUB]

All [C1] graphics sit flat on top like screenprint, flat and matte, with no glow. Palette: off-white, grey photo and [C1] only. Minimal, technical, outdoorsy. Scanned-paper grain throughout.
style 02 / 08[ F3 ]

Giant halftone numeral with 1-bit photo

Giant halftone number, the product as a 1-bit print.

A [FORMAT] poster on warm cream paper with an offset halftone texture. A colossal black halftone numeral "[TITLE]" fills the frame edge to edge, its body rendered as a coarse dot screen that fades from solid black to grey dots.

Overlapping the numeral in the lower middle, a 1-bit dithered close-up photo of [SUBJECT] in signal [C1], cut out cleanly, about 45 percent of the frame width. A small [C1] cross-stitch grid motif in one bottom corner.

Top right, a crisp white pill badge with a thin outline holding a short lowercase line in a clean sans-serif. Bottom, one tidy centred lowercase line in the same sans: [SUB].

Palette: cream, black and [C1] only, white for the badge. Refined, clean, offset print texture. No gradients except the halftone, no extra text.
style 03 / 08[ B1 ]

Object in front of giant type

Product in front of giant type. Pure ad.

A [FORMAT] advertising poster with a solid [C1] background and a very subtle studio gradient towards the bottom. A huge, tightly kerned heavy condensed grotesk sans-serif word "[TITLE]" in [C2] fills the upper 60 percent of the frame almost edge to edge, letters touching each other, all caps.

[SUBJECT] sits in the lower centre, photographed in crisp high-end studio light, large (about 55 percent of the frame width), placed in front of the bottom half of the letters so it overlaps and hides part of them, casting a soft realistic shadow onto the type and the background.

Top left and top right, tiny two-line [C2] labels in a light sans-serif. Bottom centre, three short lines of small [C2] body copy, centred. Bottom corners, a tiny logo mark and a short code: [SUB].

Palette: [C1] background, [C2] type, the natural colours of the product. Clean, premium, photorealistic product with flat graphic type. No extra objects, no drop shadows on the text, no clutter.
style 04 / 08[ B7 ]

Liquid chrome type

Liquid chrome lettering, 3D render feel.

A [FORMAT] poster on a seamless light grey studio background with a soft gradient to warm white at the top. The word or number "[TITLE]" as inflated liquid chrome 3D lettering occupying the central 70 percent of the frame, letterforms swollen and fluid, melting into each other where they touch. Mirror-polished surface reflecting a large softbox and a pale sky, crisp specular highlights, subtle warm and cool tints in the reflections, a soft contact shadow below.

Bottom edge, a single line of small letterspaced black caps centred; top corners, two tiny two-line labels in a light sans-serif: [SUB].

Palette: grey, white, chrome and a touch of warm gold in the reflections. Premium high-resolution 3D render, perfectly clean. No other objects, no text effects, no clutter.
style 05 / 08[ F6 ]

Venetian louver type

Rave flyer, letters made of lit slats.

A [FORMAT] brutalist rave flyer on pure black. A single ultra-bold word "[TITLE]" stacked vertically down the centre, one letter per row, each letter built from ribbed 3D venetian-blind louvers: horizontal slats in electric [C1] fading to black at their edges, as if lit from inside.

Behind the letters, a row of vertical glowing airbrushed lozenge shapes in [C1] and [C2], backlit and grainy. One crisp white horizontal band crosses the middle with a single line of small black monospace lowercase text: [SUB].

Palette: black, [C1], [C2] and one white band. High contrast, electric, film grain. No other text, no images.
style 06 / 08[ E3 ]

Dreamcore

Dreamcore hills, a little bit wrong on purpose.

A [FORMAT] dreamcore poster. Oversaturated hyper-green rolling hills fill the lower half, a deep saturated blue sky with thick painterly clouds frozen mid-motion fills the upper half. [SUBJECT] stands alone in the middle ground at a slightly wrong scale, its shadow pointing the wrong way. A small tear in the sky reveals a soft pink void behind it. No people.

Top, an elegant script word paired with a bold condensed grotesk word "[TITLE]" beneath it. Two large single-word labels in a bold condensed sans placed across the middle of the image on either side of the subject. Small handwritten captions tucked in the bottom corners: [SUB].

Palette: saturated green, deep blue, white clouds, soft pink and the subject's colours. Heavy vintage paper grain and crease texture, warm nostalgic but slightly unsettling stillness. All text in English. No extra objects.
style 07 / 08[ F5 ]

Pixel-mosaic silhouette nature print

The product as a window into a landscape.

A [FORMAT] art print on pale bone-white paper with subtle grain. Centre, one large silhouette of [SUBJECT], about 70 percent of the frame height, filled with a tiled, stepped pixel-mosaic of a photograph of [SETTING], so the landscape becomes the subject; the edges follow the silhouette in hard pixel steps with no anti-aliasing.

Floating in the open background, one flat [C1] pixel-stair shape like a low-resolution selection. A thin bare branch crosses one corner, and nested into it three tiny square photo tiles with thin white borders showing details of the same place. A tiny caption in a clean grotesk at the bottom: [SUB].

Palette: bone white, the natural photo tones inside the silhouette and one flat [C1] accent. Quiet, surreal, gallery print. No other text, no gradients outside the photo fill.
style 08 / 08[ F9 ]

Sky-filled silhouettes grid

Gallery print, silhouettes filled with sky.

A [FORMAT] conceptual art print on pure black. Four large silhouettes of [SUBJECT] arranged in a stacked vertical grid, slightly staggered left and right, each about 22 percent of the frame height. Each silhouette is filled with a tiled, stepped pixel-mosaic of the same photograph of [SETTING], masked into the shapes in blocky pixel steps, with crisp hard pixel edges and no anti-aliasing.

Bottom centre, a tiny clean grotesk caption in white: [SUB].

Palette: black and the natural photo tones only. Minimal, surreal, gallery print, subtle print grain on the photo fill. No other text, no gradients.

Bonus:
the whole kit

Pick your favorite design, select it and paste this. Arti keeps the style and builds new pieces around it, not copies.

This is my favorite design. Use it as the visual system for the HUSH brand, not as a template to copy. Keep the system: grayscale photo of the headphones, flat fluorescent signal red graphics on top, scanned off-white paper with fold creases, the chunky rounded "HUSH 01" logotype, narrow condensed caps, pill stamps, bracket glyphs and the small red icons.

Now design 6 NEW pieces. Each one must have a different composition, a different view or crop of the headphones and different copy. Never repeat the same layout or the same photo:

1. Vertical poster 3:4: an extreme close-up crop of one ear cup and the lattice frame filling the whole frame, the red "HUSH 01" small in a corner, a big red pill "40H OF QUIET".
2. Instagram post 4:5: the headphones seen from the side, small in the lower third, a huge red condensed headline across the top "TURN THE CITY DOWN.", a row of red icons with tiny captions.
3. Instagram story 9:16: the headphones from above lying flat, a vertical red stack of specs "NOISE TESTED / 40H BATTERY / 220G / SERIES 01", a red arrow and "SWIPE UP" at the bottom.
4. Horizontal web banner 16:9: three small grayscale headphones in a row from three angles like a technical spec sheet, red lines and labels pointing to the parts, "HUSH 01, SILENCE GEAR" on the left.
5. Product box, front and side in a 3/4 view: off-white box, grayscale headphones photo on the front, red logotype, a red tear strip on the side with "CITY DIVISION".
6. A sheet of 6 die cut stickers on off-white backing: the logo, the "NOISE TESTED" pill, the crosshair icon, "[ 2026 ]", a small headphones silhouette and "SHH".

Same headphones as the reference in every piece (exact shape, white lattice frame, knit cushions), same red, same paper. The red ink is flat and matte, no glow. All text in English, no other text.
